Title: Question: Sascha Vykos vs Rotschreck LSJ

Messages.Author: SteveHarris
Messages.Body:
If a minion blocks Sascha Vykos (advanced version) and that minions's
Methuselah plays Rotschreck, does Sascha's Methuselah get a chance to
draw a card prior to Sascha going to torpor?

Sascha Vykos, The Angel of Caine (Advanced)
"Advanced, Sabbat Archbishop of Washington, D.C.: If Sascha is ready,
you may draw a card from your library whenever another Methuselah
plays a master card.
[MERGED ICON] Sabbat cardinal."

Rötschreck
Master: out-of-turn. Frenzy. Put this card on a vampire when an
opposing minion attempts to inflict aggravated damage on him or her,
whether the damage would be successfully inflicted or not. Combat
ends. This vampire is tapped and sent to torpor. This vampire does not
untap as normal. During this vampire's next untap phase, burn this
card.

Messages.Author: LSJ
